name: Laurence G. Hanscom Field

noise.v: no night ban, but a nighttime field use charge for every operation 23:00-07:00 local (doubled after five in a year; Hanscom-based aircraft exempt); touch-and-go and use of APUs/GPUs outside hangars banned 23:00-07:00
noise.quote: any aircraft operating at Hanscom between the hours of 11:00 P.M. and 7:00 A.M. ("nighttime hours")

max_aircraft.v: fixed-wing aircraft over 12,500 lb must meet FAR Part 36 noise rules; no commercial passenger service with aircraft of more than 60 seats
max_aircraft.quote: shall conduct at Hanscom an operation in commercial air passenger service

missing: curfew (regulation sets a night charge, not a ban)
